Consonantal i

Consonantal u

Theme

Common words: verbs, qualities & ideas

unclear adjective

hard to understand

also not clear, obscure, vague, confusing, ambiguous, evasive, indecisive

classical

Hor. AP 25–26: brevis esse labōrō, obscūrus fīō
Cic. Brut. 152: obscūram explānāre interpretandō

obscūrus, obscūra, obscūrum

declension

obscure, unclear, hard to make out

Literally “dark”: of words, writing and ideas, “indistinct, unintelligible” (Lewis & Short).

Other words

  • ambiguus, ambigua, ambiguum — ambiguous, open to two meanings

    declension · also used · classical · Cic. Brut. 152: ambigua prīmum vidēre, deinde distinguere; Cic. de Or. 2.110: sī est scrīptum aliquid ambiguē; Traupman 152, 154; Traupman 310

Examples

  • brevis esse labōrō, obscūrus fīō

    I try to be brief, and I become obscureHor. AP 25–26

  • latentem explicāre dēfīniendō, obscūram explānāre interpretandō, ambigua prīmum vidēre, deinde distinguere

    to bring out what is hidden by defining it, to make plain what is obscure by explaining it, first to see what is ambiguous and then to draw distinctionsCic. Brut. 152

See also clearly, understand, unclear, explain.
